In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by [[Sharad Hett]] '''attacked''' the trading site of [[Mochot Steep/Legends|Mochot Steep]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which was full of civilians buying weapons with which to protect themselves from the increasingly violent Tuskens. Among the [[Death/Legends|killed]] were a [[Unidentified moisture farmer (Tatooine)|moisture farmer]], a [[Unidentified Trandoshan arms dealer|Trandoshan arms dealer]], and [[Conil Barje]]. Hett spared Barje's [[Camelle Barje|wife]] and [[Tekil Barje|baby]].
